column7: KEK-derived HKDF keys (evidence-signing, audit-checkpoint, backup-manifest) panicked under GODEBUG=fips140=only on a KEK shorter than 14 bytes ("crypto/hkdf: use of keys shorter than 112 bits is not allowed in FIPS 140-only mode") and silently derived a key from it in default mode. deriveEvidenceSignKey, deriveAuditCheckpointKey and auditverify.DeriveBackupManifestKey now refuse a KEK below MinKEKLen (14) with a typed *KEKTooShortError (errors.Is ErrKEKTooShort) and no key material, identically in both modes; callers already propagate the error and fail closed. Golden vectors for 14- and 32-byte KEKs recorded before the change pin that no stored checkpoint or evidence signature changes. Reachability: the providers and the AES key-size check of the DEK wrap reject a sub-16-byte KEK before Initialize derives anything (TestInitialize_ShortKEKProvider_FailsClosed), so the panic was latent behind those layers. Red at edc8f0c5b: panic under fips140=only, no error in default mode. FIPS-TAILS-1 item 1.
